notes: In the safe room Donut opens a Gold Magic Item Box (for being one of the first 100 crawlers to reach Magic Missile level 3): 25 mana potions and the Talisman of the Slate Butterfly, a collar charm that takes her Light on Your Feet skill from 3 to 7, adds +1 Intelligence and makes winged fairies non-hostile. Tally the caretaker treats her as royalty. Mana rises 17 -> 18 with the talisman's +1 Intelligence, following the rule ch08 states explicitly (mana max equals effective Intelligence); the chapter does not restate the total.

add.name: Talisman of the Slate Butterfly
add.effects: +4 to the Light on Your Feet skill; +1 Intelligence; winged fairies will no longer be automatically hostile toward you.
add.description: A little silver butterfly charm with its own ring so it attaches straight to Donut's collar; it jingles when it moves. "Those who remember and commemorate the sad tale of the Slate Butterfly are given a boon by the fairies of the world." From a Gold Magic Item Box. Carl points out that a bell round a cat's neck is there to warn the birds and squirrels; Donut wears it anyway because it's adorable.

add.name: Potion of Mana Restoration
add.description: Twenty-five mana-restoration potions from the Gold Magic Item Box.

add.name: Light on Your Feet
add.description: Lets her pounce higher and farther. She was already a three in the skill when the Talisman of the Slate Butterfly took it to seven — enough to leap twice as high as before, to the top of the restaurant playground's plastic tubes.

add.name: Fairy Neutrality
add.description: From the Talisman of the Slate Butterfly: winged fairies will no longer be automatically hostile toward Donut.

add.name: (Unnamed Magic Missile achievement)
add.reward: You've received a Gold Magic Item Box!
add.note: One of the first 100 crawlers to level Magic Missile up to level three. Reported second-hand by Carl, so the box is never shown and neither the name nor the system's wording is known.

add.name: Tally
add.note: Level 63 Non-Combatant NPC caretaker of the floor-1 safe room. Addresses Donut as 'Your Royal Highness' without being asked, gave her yogurt on arrival and special-ordered a fresh salmon, properly prepared and garnished, for when she wakes. Donut: 'It's not my fault he sees me as royalty.'

sources.quote: She had several boxes as well, including a gold magic item box she'd received for being one of the first 100 crawlers to level Magic Missile up to level three.
In the box was 25 potions of mana restoration and a collar charm. The charm was a little silver butterfly.
Talisman of the Slate Butterfly […] Adds +4 to the Light on Your Feet skill. Adds +1 to Intelligence. Winged fairies will no longer be automatically hostile toward you.
The Light on Your Feet skill simply meant she'd be able to pounce higher and farther. She was already a three in the skill when she'd received it, so the charm made her a seven.
she currently had a 17 in intelligence, giving her 17 mana points
